result.summary: Wrote lit.md for C06 seed 806 round 2 (文献员 role), answering the 4 literature questions from r2/analysis.md §6: (1) intraday volume/amount timing distribution (day_centroid core A) — U-shape origin, China-specific T+1 close-buy/open-sell mechanism, time-segmented vs. whole-day construction; (2) persistent level vs. own-history innovation decomposition for abnormal turnover (GKM2001's rank-in-trailing-window construction, CHS2001's 6-month-trend abnormal volume, Llorente et al.'s systematic/idiosyncratic split); (3) tick-rule-style intraday order imbalance (core B day_signed_ratio) in China A-shares — normalization-as-ratio convention, short predictive horizons (1-90 min), opening-session dominance, conflicting large/small-trade informedness evidence (bull vs bear, China vs US); (4) nonlinear/fold/threshold characteristics vs. linear neutralization — nonparametric alternatives (Freyberger-Neuhierl-Weber), formal monotonicity testing (Patton-Timmermann), China shell-value distortion in the smallest-30% (Liu-Stambaugh-Yuan), low-nominal-price premium in US (Birru-Wang) vs. China (Zhang 2023, cash-flow-beta explanation not mispricing), and a caution that long-only portfolios should NOT sector-neutralize (Ehsani-Harvey-Li), contra one of the PI's suggestions. Each processing method is cited to a bibliography entry with title/authors/year-month/source/link/verified flag; all 20 sources were confirmed via WebSearch results or direct WebFetch/PDF reads (two source PDFs were read page-by-page for exact formulas). Items that could not be found with pre-2023-08-08 confirmation (A-share order-imbalance 2018-2021 vs 2022+ subsample stability, tick-rule classification accuracy specifically on A-share data, a literature version of "cheap but not cheapest" non-monotonic pricing) are explicitly logged as not-found rather than fabricated. Stayed within rules.md's readable-paths restriction throughout (read only rules.md, this round's own analysis.md, and partura/ops_ext.py for operator semantics).
